fusions.name: Slip Behind
fusions.desc: Slips you up to a target within 5 tiles, then cuts for 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Fan
fusions.desc: Looses 3 palmed blades at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Edge from Nowhere
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 12 seconds and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Back in Hand
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical chance rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
